_doc: Sovereign production-baseline scaffold. DO NOT commit the EXAMPLE file to production. Copy this to packages/db/fixtures/baseline.<run-name>.json, fill every field with sovereign-approved values, then run: SOVEREIGN_BASELINE_APPROVED=<receipt-id> npm run db:seed:baseline
